title: Certify Bool-only predicates from the legacy proof object in Lean
summary: Inputs whose only uninterpreted symbols are predicates over Bool, with no uninterpreted sort, are now classified as QF_UF, exported from the legacy proof object, and certified in Lean. Python-only change; the local gate passed with 60, 183, and 46 tests OK and both regression matrix cells fully Lean-verified.
